model.catalog_policy: Record hash before and after each complete batch; any exposed model/catalog change invalidates cross-arm comparability and requires the complete affected batch rerun. Never substitute a fallback.

scoring.facts: One point per semantically correct required atomic fact. Exact numbers/booleans, declared signature/type aliases and per-field order policies are machine-checkable. Do not mark a correct novel paraphrase wrong merely because it is outside an alias list; send it to blinded semantic review.
scoring.citations: Each required supported fact needs at least one returned source/evidence ID that actually supports it; invented/out-of-scope IDs fail citation credit.
scoring.unsupported_claims: Record count separately; do not offset them with extra correct facts.
scoring.uncertainty: Correct state and boundary required for uncertainty questions; saying unknown for an established pilot fact earns no fact credit.
scoring.grading: Record protocol/schema validity separately from semantic fact correctness. Validate keys/types, normalize only explicitly permitted equivalents, then compare atomic facts. Free prose reasons and ambiguous novel forms require blinded evidence review; no hidden literal-code match. Preserve raw answers and all adjudications.
scoring.blinding: Remove profile label and randomize trial order before independent grading where feasible; retain a separate private mapping for aggregate reporting.

equivalence_rules.signatures: Remove only known pilot namespace/type qualification; normalize whitespace/type aliases without changing arity, signedness or width. Never equate narrow and wide overloads.
equivalence_rules.expressions: Ignore formatting whitespace outside literals; known qualifier removal allowed; value>0 and 0<value equivalent only for this side-effect-free parameter test.
equivalence_rules.states: Normalize spaces/hyphens to underscores for known state labels; never equate unknown with not_collected.
equivalence_rules.reason_prose: Assess the expected causal concept with source evidence; exact internal code optional.
equivalence_rules.arrays: Use each question array_semantics. Unordered sets ignore item order but reject duplicates as a separately recorded format issue; exact set membership still matters.
equivalence_rules.fallback: Unknown wording goes to blinded review; unresolved grading cannot be presented as a scored completed result.

failure_policy: Preserve every scheduled trial, including timeout, malformed response, nonprotocol tool use, missing usage, query failure, budget exhaustion or missing output. No selective favorable retries; a transport correction creates a new versioned complete batch, retaining failed batch results.

measurement.monetary_cost_state: unknown for the current ChatGPT-account route unless a usable rate is supplied; never record zero

later_milestones: Keep all 24 question texts and attempts. Freeze stage-specific gold amendments before querying new outputs when recorded build evidence or supported analyses change; preserve old gold and evidence. Do not drop unavailable questions.
